title: European lawmaker presents Lai with statement in support of Taiwan
summary: Taipei, Oct. 28 (CNA) A member of the European Parliament (MEP) has presented President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) with a joint statement signed by more than 30 lawmakers from across Europe, saying it reflected a time-tested friendship between Taiwan and Europe.

title: Saint Lucian prime minister in Taiwan for state visit: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre arrived in Taiwan on Tuesday morning for a five-day state visit, during which he will meet with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and other officials to discuss bilateral issues.
